svg.title: Binary-cycle geothermal plant — Tvívökvavirkjun
svg.desc: Deep geothermal well pipes meet a central heat exchanger, while a separate closed loop drives a turbine and condenser.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-geothermal-binary","label_en":"Binary-cycle geothermal plant","label_is":"Tvívökvavirkjun","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","geothermal"],"description":"Deep geothermal well pipes meet a central heat exchanger, while a separate closed loop drives a turbine and condenser.","design_note":"Two separated fluid circuits joined only through a heat exchanger are the defining binary-cycle feature.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
